response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer with deep web/full-stack experience (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) and some systems-level work, but the role demands 8–12 years of hands-on C++ expertise plus industrial cybersecurity (IEC 62443, SDL) and IoT/MQTT experience. His C++ exposure is limited to a short stint at National Instruments (2014–2015) and a thesis project, and there is no evidence of secure development lifecycle practice, industrial protocols, or message-broker-based C++ systems. Despite genuine seniority and mentoring credentials, the core technical mismatch is too large for this specific position.
strengths: Extensive senior-level engineering experience across web, backend, and embedded domains
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work (millions of requests/sec) using async I/O and concurrency in DLang
Strong mentoring, testing culture (TDD), and technical communication demonstrated through workshops and talks
concerns: Minimal professional C++ experience — only ~7 months at National Instruments in 2014–2015
No industrial cybersecurity, IEC 62443, or Secure Development Lifecycle background
No MQTT, industrial automation protocols, or Azure experience; recent career trajectory is web/AI tooling, not systems C++
